Daily Quiz.question: ১) Choose the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) We take decisions based on some informations.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) We take decision based on some information.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) We take decisions based on some information.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) We take decision based on some informations.
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Decision’ is a countable noun if it means 'a choice' or 'a judgment'. ‘Information’ is an uncountable noun.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) I’ve done it __________ of times.
Daily Quiz.exp: If there is ‘of’ after hundred, dozen, score, thousand, then ‘s’ is added to the word to make it plural.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which of the following is in plural form?
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Banditti' is the plural form of the singular word ‘Bandit’.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which one is singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Innings' is the only singular form here. Public, Cattle, Vitals ইত্যাদি সর্বদা plural হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Which of the following words is in singular form?
Daily Quiz.exp: Syllabi is the plural form of Syllabus; Formulae is of Formula; Strata is of Stratum; but ‘bowls’ is a sport. বিভিন্ন খেলার নাম, যেমনঃ Darts, Billiards, Draughts, Dominoes, Bowls ইত্যাদি singular হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Identify the word that can be used as both singular and plural.
Daily Quiz.exp: ‘সমষ্টিগতভাবে’ বুঝালে fish-এর plural form ‘fish’-ই হয়। ‘ভিন্নজাতীয়’ বুঝালে fish-এর plural form হয় ‘fishes’।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Which one’s singular and plural form are the same?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Plural form of ‘Canon’ is ‘Canon’.
But the singular and plural form of ‘Cannon’ are 'Cannon/Cannons' both.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Which of the following doesn’t add ‘ves’ in the plural form?
Daily Quiz.exp: The plural form of ‘Dwarf’ is ‘Dwarfs’.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Which of the following words is in singular form?
Daily Quiz.exp: The plural form of ‘Synopsis’ is ‘Synopses’.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) The plural form of ‘alphabet’ is-
Daily Quiz.exp: There are some nouns which are always singular. Such as- abuse, advice, alphabet, bread, information, knowledge, poetry, offspring, etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Which one is singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: There are some words which are always plural. Such as- alms, amends, ashes, bowels, fetters, savings, scissors, spectacles, surroundings. বিভিন্ন খেলার নাম, যেমনঃ Darts, Billiards, Draughts, Dominoes, Bowls ইত্যাদি singular হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The plural form of ‘Apex’ is-
Daily Quiz.exp: According to the rules of Number, if a singular number word ends with ix/ex, there will need ‘es’ or ‘ices’ to make it plural.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Which of the following is singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: Syllabi (pl.) – syllabus (sing.); phenomena (pl.) – phenomenon (sing.); premium (singular) – premia (pl.); media (pl.) – medium (sing.)

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Which one is plural?
Daily Quiz.exp: Before a number, symbol or letter, apostrophe (’s) is used to make it plural. For example, 10’s, Ten’s, B.A.’s, etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Which of the following is singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: Uncountable noun advice, bread, baggage, equipment ইত্যাদি singular।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Which one is not plural?
Daily Quiz.exp: Poultry, Vermin, Aristocracy, Gentry ইত্যাদি সর্বদা plural হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) What is the feminine of ‘Man-servant’?
Daily Quiz.exp: Man-servant (চাকর) - Maid-servant (চাকরানী)

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) What is the feminine of ‘Negro’?
Daily Quiz.exp: কতগুলো Masculine-এর শেষ অংশ যেমনঃ ro, ror, rer, tor এগুলো বাদ দিয়ে ess যোগ করে feminine form গঠন করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Find the odd one out.
Daily Quiz.exp: Correct pair is: host (mas.) - hostess (fem.)

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) The opposite gender of ‘earl’ is-
Daily Quiz.exp: ‘Earl’ refers to (the title of) a British man of high social rank which feminine form is ‘Countees’.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) What is the feminine of ‘Testator’?
Daily Quiz.exp: কতগুলো Foreign Masculine-এর শেষে tor থাকলে তা বাদ দিয়ে trix যোগ করে feminine form গঠন করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Which one is incorrect?
Daily Quiz.exp: The correct pair is ‘Bridegroom - Bride’.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Opposite gender of ‘hart’-
Daily Quiz.exp: Hart (a male deer) - Roe (a female deer)

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) What is the masculine of ‘duck’?
Daily Quiz.exp: Drake- a male duck, gander- a male goose, rooster- an adult male chicken, hind- a female deer.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) What is the feminine of ‘Bullock’?
Daily Quiz.exp: Bullock (a young bull/a young male cow) - Heifer (a young female cow)

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) Which of the following nouns is neuter gender?
Daily Quiz.exp: Noun যদি জড়পদার্থ বা প্রাণহীন বুঝায় তবে তা Neuter Gender হয়। কিন্তু জড়পদার্থ না হওয়া সত্ত্বেও baby, child, mouse, dog, cat, bird ইত্যাদি Neuter Gender।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Which of the following pairs of nouns is composed of males and females?
Daily Quiz.exp: Correct pairs are- Hen-Cock, Stag-Hind, Lad-Lass.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) What is the feminine of ‘Colt’?
Daily Quiz.exp: Colt (বাচ্চা ঘোড়া) - Filly (বাচ্চা ঘোটকী)

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Which one is not a neutral gender?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Sheep (common/neutral) : Ram (mas.) - Ewe (fem.)
Swan (common/neutral): Cob (mas.) - Pen (fem.)
Fowl (common/neutral): Cock (mas.) - Hen (fem.)
Server (common/neutral): Waiter (mas.) - Waitress (fem.)

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Which one is feminine gender?
Daily Quiz.exp: Hope, justice, liberty, mercy, moon, night, spring, truth, autumn এগুলোর নমনীয়তা, সৌন্দর্য, কোমলতা ইত্যাদি নারীসুলভ গুণ থাকায় এদেরকে feminine gender হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়। অন্যদিকে, time, death, winter, anger, love, revenge, summer, war এদের শক্তি, পুরুষোচিত গুণ থাকায় এদেরকে masculine gender হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়।
